2609.30714.title: CRC-Router: Risk-Constrained Routing for Medical Agentic AI Systems
2609.30714.paper_summary: Agentic AI systems are increasingly being explored in medical imaging to improve throughput and reduce clinician workload; however, safe deployment remains challenging because autonomous errors may propagate into downstream clinical decisions. A central requirement is therefore not only strong predictive performance, but also a reliable routing mechanism that determines when the system should proceed autonomously and when a case should be escalated for further review. To address this gap, we propose CRC-Router, a risk-constrained, uncertainty-aware routing module that is applicable to both conventional medical prediction models and agentic medical AI systems. CRC-Router combines multiple complementary uncertainty signals with the predictive score to construct a per-finding routing feature vector, maps this vector to an estimated wrong-accept risk using a lightweight per-finding risk model, and then applies Conformal Risk Control (CRC) to calibrate acceptance thresholds under a user-specified risk target. Instantiated on chest X-ray multi-finding triage using the NIH ChestX-ray14 dataset, CRC-Router achieves the strongest empirical risk--coverage trade-off among the evaluated baselines, both as a standalone routing layer and as a plug-in module integrated with the state-of-the-art MedRAX agent. These results demonstrate both the effectiveness of CRC-Router in selective medical automation and its modular, model-agnostic compatibility with existing predictive and agentic medical pipelines. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/XLIAaron/CRC-Router
2609.30714.paper_summary_zh: 代理型人工智慧系統在醫學影像領域的探索日益增多，以提高通量並減少臨床醫師的工作負擔；然而，安全部署仍然面臨挑戰，因為自主錯誤可能會傳播到下游的臨床決策中。因此，一個核心需求不僅是強大的預測性能，還需要一個可靠的路由機制，以決定系統何時應該自主進行，何時應該將案例升級以進行進一步審查。為了解決這一問題，我們提出了CRC-Router，一個風險約束、具不確定性感知的路由模塊，適用於傳統醫學預測模型和代理型醫學人工智慧系統。CRC-Router結合多個互補的不確定性信號與預測分數，構建每個發現的路由特徵向量，並使用輕量級的每個發現風險模型將該向量映射到估計的錯誤接受風險，然後應用符合風險控制（CRC）來校準在用戶指定的風險目標下的接受閾值。在使用NIH ChestX-ray14數據集的胸部X光多發現分診上實現，CRC-Router在評估的基準中達到了最強的實證風險-覆蓋權衡，無論是作為獨立的路由層，還是作為與最先進的MedRAX代理集成的插件模塊。這些結果展示了CRC-Router在選擇性醫療自動化中的有效性，以及其與現有預測和代理型醫療管道的模塊化、模型無關的兼容性。代碼可在 https://github.com/XLIAaron/CRC-Router 獲得。
